simulation.extension.host-profile-native: The exact three TEST root contracts are embedded and digest-bound in a natively rebuildable host profile.

simulation.extension.branch-package-nati: Assessment reuses the Branch Module Return Gate verifier without extracting or executing candidate bytes.
simulation.extension.root-identity-colli: A candidate cannot reuse any protected root module id.
simulation.extension.truth-rule-preserva: Adapters may translate but cannot replace roots, discard unsupported fields or change invariant truth rules.
simulation.extension.subject-mapping-ver: Every declared software, Mirror or specialist subject must map exact candidate handoffs to a provided host capability.
simulation.extension.permission-expansio: Candidate manifest, contract, return declaration and extension declaration must all retain zero permissions.

simulation.extension.evaluation-requirem: A static pass emits claim-specific NOT_RUN requirements; it does not manufacture runtime proof.
simulation.extension.human-value-separat: Human comprehension and value remain routed to explicit voluntary human judgment.
simulation.extension.adoption.none: Static readiness grants no execution, install, adoption, graft, merge, CANON or Foundation authority.

simulation.extension.current-zero-candid: The readiness receipt records zero candidate packages, assessments, plans and evaluations.

simulation.extension.candidate-package.r: No Platform or other branch candidate package has been supplied.

simulation.extension.candidate-runtime.v: No candidate exists, so isolated runtime evaluation is NOT_RUN.

growth.human-evidence.live: No person has judged a future candidate useful in a voluntary live trial.
